assertion_independence: No added assertion merely compares an echoed supplied scalar with itself; expected path membership is checked against a transformed index view, and performance counts are measured by a wrapper around the real builder.

assertion_review.failure_condition: Fixture index missing or not holding 2000 entries fails setup.
A leaked tick context fails the outside-tick precondition.
A missing pointer or collapsed classification row fails the independently fixed population counts.
An unreadable classification fails; another incorrect readable classification does not, as the finding records.
Bypassing the measured builder fails the positive control; reinstating the base uncached branch yields 540 and fails <=1.
Mutating a held snapshot in place fails old-view absence; ignoring index version fails new-path presence and size; uncached reads fail the build count.
Cross-store cache confusion fails the independent expected path sets; removing reuse fails identity and builder count.
Keying by version alone after a generation change returns first.json instead of replacement.json and fails both assertions.

findings.text: non-blocking: The committed classification assertion only rejects unreadable, so a change from promotable to another readable classification would stay green; the base/head equality check exists in the run receipts but has no durable regression assertion.
